title: Ridgeline Installation Services Start-of-Work Payment — Customer Card Payment Tool
content:
This rule fixes the start-of-work payment a customer makes on a Ridgeline Installation Services contract whose status is in progress, charged to the customer's own bank card.

## When the amount is worked out

- The start-of-work payment is not worked out until every installation visit on the contract at which the customer was absent or the site was not ready carries its trip charge line.
- The start-of-work payment is fixed only after every signed change order that raises the contract price carries its administration fee line.
- Before the start-of-work payment is fixed, an issued permit whose fee is passed through at cost must carry its permit handling fee line on the contract.

Each clause speaks of lines standing on the contract: as long as any of those lines is missing from the contract, the start-of-work payment is not yet fixed.

## Contract and tender

- The contract's status, as the contract record shows it, is in progress.
- The payment is charged to the customer's own bank card.

## Invocation

The payment is made with `pay_progress_payment_cb1125dd`, a tool the customer runs for themselves. The agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to authorize the charge to their own bank card. One run records one payment toward that contract, dated today, with tender bank card and purpose progress payment, and lowers the contract's balance due by the amount paid; the customer receives a payment confirmation and sees the lower balance due.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `install_contract_id` | the reference number of the installation contract being paid, as given to the customer by the agent from the installation contract lookup | identifier, exactly as returned |
| `payment_amount` | the amount charged to the customer's bank card, in USD | a positive amount written to 2 decimal places (cents); a value with more decimals is rounded half to even to the cent when it is recorded |

## Return

A receipt with `install_charge_id` (the reference number of the payment line), `install_contract_id` (the contract paid), `contract_number` (the contract number exactly as on the contract), `payment_method` (always `bank_card`), `payment_purpose` (always `progress_payment`), `amount` (the amount charged, in USD to 2 decimal places), `charge_date` (today's payment date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `balance_due` (the contract's balance due after the payment, in USD to 2 decimal places). A receipt carrying an `install_charge_id` means the payment is recorded.
